task_instruction: Rewrite each active sentence in the passive voice.
paragraphs: A city office is explaining how traffic fines are handled. The notice lists the rules in simple language. {{red:Drivers must obey the speed limit on this road.}} {{mask_1}} {{red:Officers can record a violation with a camera.}} {{mask_2}} {{red:The city will send a fine notice to the registered vehicle owner.}} {{mask_3}} {{red:Drivers should read the notice carefully.}} {{mask_4}}

The office explains what happens after a notice arrives. {{red:People may pay the fine online.}} {{mask_5}} {{red:The payment system will accept card payments.}} {{mask_6}} {{red:Drivers must include the notice number with their payment.}} {{mask_7}} {{red:The office can answer questions by phone.}} {{mask_8}}

A driver can check the details before paying. {{red:Staff will review a reported mistake.}} {{mask_9}} {{red:Drivers may ask the office for more information.}} {{mask_10}} {{red:The city must protect personal information.}} {{mask_11}} {{red:An officer can explain the reason for the fine.}} {{mask_12}}

The office also describes the next steps. {{red:Drivers should keep a copy of the receipt.}} {{mask_13}} {{red:The payment service will email a receipt to the driver.}} {{mask_14}} {{red:The office may extend the payment date in special cases.}} {{mask_15}} {{red:Drivers must update their contact details.}} {{mask_16}}

The city wants every driver to understand the process. {{red:Officials will publish the payment instructions online.}} {{mask_17}} {{red:Drivers can appeal a fine through the city website.}} {{mask_18}} {{red:The review team will check each appeal.}} {{mask_19}} {{red:The city should explain every decision clearly.}} {{mask_20}} The office advises drivers to read official notices and meet the payment deadline.
